column1: # jespersen's own Portuguese word list (CC0): words respelt for what the spelling rules would miss.
# One per line: the word in lower case, a tab, its respelling. An acute accent marks an open e or o
# under the stress (éla, pórta), a circumflex a closed one (fôgo); a respelling may also change
# letters (táksi, prósimo). The rules close a stressed e and o unless written é and ó or before a
# final l (papel, sol), so this list holds the common words with an open vowel the spelling does
# not show, and the words whose x is not ʃ.
# Words the rules would otherwise misread.
# The -era of the pluperfect and the past is open (fizera, estiveram).
